note: In-system freight for ships with no FTL drive. Every system has its main port plus a fuel depot, a moon base and a belt works (assumed, not yet on the world map). A hop between two sites costs delta-v and hours; fuel burned follows the rocket equation from the ship's mass, so heavy loads and long hops eat the tank. Pay is per tonne per km/s of delta-v, scaled by the difficulty level's local_pay_mult (solved with tests/solve_local.gd).
